answer: Since the throttle counters live in the forge ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 163 keys as a result pays for 163 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the beacon quota and the river admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 5 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. That is 33 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
